title: Motion production responsibility boundaries
prompt: Three independent briefs arrive: A) a keyboard-accessible drawer must reverse smoothly when clicked again; B) a large interactive shader field needs GPU performance work; C) a narrated product film needs storyboard, scene continuity, fixed timeline and frame-by-frame MP4 export. Identify owners, knowledge to reuse and evidence each delivery needs. Can one agent coordinate C without duplicating the other specialties? Do not spawn agents or claim execution.

checks.reason: Routing-level signal only; assess reasoning and evidence through the rubric.

rubric: Routes live DOM interaction to ui-motion-specialist and GPU implementation to browser-graphics-specialist.
Routes the exported audiovisual piece to motion-graphics-producer with deterministic-motion-rendering for export semantics.
Preserves ownership of visual identity, interactive behavior and GPU engineering; independent auditing belongs to design-qa-specialist.
Does not require automatic multi-agent execution; names separate interaction, performance, media and narrative evidence.
acceptance: The response makes the justified decisions, identifies discriminating project-level checks, and states evidence limits without inventing execution. Static validation and keyword matching do not prove runtime behavior.
